data_fields.name: trade_both_accept
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: trade commits only when both sides accepted; any veto resets both

best_idea: A multi-requirement spend is planned in full against remainders and only then applied, so a failed requirement changes nothing and reports the line that failed.
decision_why: Keep check-then-apply for craft, buy and trade and the two-sided accept with veto; fix the overlapping-requirement defect (plan against remainders) and the no-rollback trade apply; reject the order-dependent adjacency grouping.
acceptance: A bag with 15 gold and a line needing 10 gold twice shows 'line 2 short: 5 more gold' and the bag is unchanged; a server test asserts a refused spend leaves every stack amount identical.
